origin:veteran.text: Served many hard campaigns on the northern borders before arriving in {town}.

origin:devout.text: Raised within the cloistered walls of the sanctuary, dedicated early to faith.

origin:coastal.text: Born to fisherfolk on salt-sprayed shores, drifting inland until settling in {town}.

origin:artisan.text: Apprenticed from childhood to the trade, mastering materials and form.

origin:hearth.text: Grew up in a crowded homestead where bread was shared and hearthfires never died.

origin:drifter.text: Walked roads without end across the kingdoms before pausing in {town}.

event:skirmish.text: Stood firm during the brutal winter raid on {place}, earning scars and solemn silence.

event:miracle.text: Witnessed what elders called a divine sign during the great famine, cementing lifelong conviction.

event:fire.text: Survived the great fire that consumed the lower quarter, salvaging only a handful of tools.

event:discovery.text: Uncovered ancient ruins in the deep woods, glimpsing secrets not meant for mortal eyes.

want:glory.text: Yearns to perform a deed sung of across the realms.

want:peace.text: Desires nothing more than an undisturbed garden and an end to bloodshed.

want:mastery.text: Strives day and night to perfect their craft beyond any living peer.

want:wealth.text: Seeks enough coin to buy total freedom and comfort for their kin.

flaw:wrath.text: Slow to forget slights and quick to strike when pride is bruised.

flaw:distrust.text: Sees betrayal behind every friendly smile and hides true thoughts.

flaw:pride.text: Cannot bear being contradicted or corrected, even when plainly mistaken.

flaw:fear.text: Haunted by nightmares of violence, flinching at shadows in the dark.
